description: Request parameters passed to IDropdownDataProvider<T>.GetItemsAsync(). Contains search text, pagination settings, and exclusion filters.

properties.name: SearchText
properties.description: The user's current search/filter text. Empty string means no filter.

properties.name: PageSize
properties.description: Maximum items to return per page.

properties.name: ExcludedIds
properties.description: Item IDs to exclude from results (e.g., already-selected items in multi-select).
